summary: App Clips are a lightweight part of an app that Apple installs on demand from invocation URLs, App Clip Codes and the App Store. BifrOSt has no on-demand install and no App Clip card, so those rows are n/a. Web link routing to an app (app_links.rs) is a partial counterpart for the invocation URL step; shared defaults and keychain cover the data sharing with a full app. iPadOS 14.0 and later per the index.
rea_evidence: not captured: REA capture pending (tools/parity/rea-page.sh not run this round; owner rule); facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: A site path opens the app with the longest matching prefix; there is no activation payload or invocation context.

features.feature: On-demand install of the App Clip
features.apple: App Clip card, on-demand install entitlement
features.note: Depends on Apple's App Store on-demand install service.
Apple's code format and NFC registration; no counterpart.

features.feature: Data sharing with the full app
features.note: Both are per-app stores; no shared container between an app and its clip.

features.feature: Recommend the full app from the clip
features.note: No overlay or transition from a small app to a full one.
Notifications exist for apps; the time-limited clip permission does not.
Entitlement and bundle linking are Apple's signing model.

gaps: No App Clip card, on-demand install or App Clip Codes; these depend on Apple services.
No overlay that recommends the full app from inside a small app.
No time-limited notification permission for small apps.
